title: Observability layer: kube-prometheus-stack, Loki, Alloy, Tetragon
description: Parent epic: infraplan-brt. observability/ layer + clusters/template/observability.yaml. Loki single-binary on EBS, Alloy collecting via the Kubernetes API, Tetragon. flux-bootstrap is reference only.

title: AWS load balancer controller consuming aws-loadbalancer-config
description: Parent epic: infraplan-brt. infrastructure/controllers/aws-load-balancer-controller with IRSA from the ConfigMap talos-ppy publishes. Blocked on talos-ppy.

title: Platform add-ons that consume talos-aws-terraform's published objects
description: talos-aws-terraform publishes cilium-config, karpenter-config, karpenter-aws-config, cloud-controller-manager-aws-config, ebs-csi-driver-aws-config, aws-loadbalancer-config and cluster-versions, and expects this repo to read them: Cilium HelmRelease adopting the bootstrap install (WireGuard strict mode, Hubble), AWS cloud controller manager, EBS CSI driver, AWS load balancer controller, Karpenter HelmRelease + EC2NodeClass + NodePool (capacity-types split), tuppr TalosUpgrade/KubernetesUpgrade. Names and shapes: talos-aws-terraform README 'Flux bootstrap repository' and modules/bootstrap.
acceptance_criteria: Every object in README.md's contract table is consumed by a manifest under the cluster template; kustomize build + kubeconform pass.

title: Cluster template: clusters/template with the bootstrap Kustomization
description: talos-aws-terraform's README tells users to copy clusters/template to clusters/<project_name> before terraform apply, and keeps a flux-kustomization.yaml (the 'bootstrap' Kustomization, path ./bootstrap, healthcheck on cert-manager) that belongs here. Add clusters/template with the Kustomization layout Flux syncs from clusters/<project_name> (flux-system/ is left to Terraform's bootstrap), including the cluster-versions postBuild.substituteFrom wiring for the tuppr upgrade resources.
acceptance_criteria: clusters/template (explicit root kustomization.yaml, layer Flux Kustomizations, per-layer overlays) builds with kustomize and validates with kubeconform; infrastructure/sources exists; README documents copying it. The 2023 'bootstrap' Kustomization from talos-aws-terraform's flux-kustomization.yaml is dropped, not carried over: per-layer Kustomizations replace it.

title: Adopt kubelet-csr-approver in Flux
description: Parent epic: infraplan-brt. infrastructure/controllers/kubelet-csr-approver HelmRelease adopting kube-system-kubelet-csr-approver (releaseName, targetNamespace and storageNamespace kube-system), values from the secret talos-5ty publishes. Blocked on talos-5ty.

title: Policy layer: Kyverno, audit-mode policies, default-deny network policies
description: Parent epic: infraplan-brt. policy/ layer + clusters/template/policy.yaml. Revisit which flux-bootstrap policies are still worth having rather than porting all.

title: CI: kustomize build + kubeconform every cluster directory on PRs
description: AGENTS.md names kustomize build | kubeconform as the quality gate. Nothing enforces it yet. Run it for each clusters/* directory on pull requests.
